referenceLibrary.title: Library
referenceLibrary.why: Why: the documents that give your data its meaning
referenceLibrary.readersHelp: Roles that read these domains read this document and draw on it. Whole organization stands alone.
referenceLibrary.urlBackgroundHelp: An http(s) address. The document is fetched in the background, and again whenever it is refreshed.
referenceLibrary.notYetIndexed: Passages appear here once the document is indexed.
referenceLibrary.citedByDriftedHelp: The quoted words are no longer in this document. Review this citation.
referenceLibrary.intro: Documents the organization's assistants draw on and cite: policies, regulations, contracts, specifications and standards. An assistant acting for a role uses a document whose domains the role reads, and every document for the whole organization.
referenceLibrary.empty: The library holds no documents yet.
referenceLibrary.fileHelp: A PDF, Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), HTML, Markdown, eCFR XML (.xml) or plain-text file.
referenceLibrary.urlHelp: An http(s) address. The document is fetched now and again whenever it is refreshed.
referenceLibrary.titleHelp: Left empty, the document's own title is used.
referenceLibrary.domainsHelp: Roles that read these domains draw on the document. Whole organization stands alone.
referenceLibrary.domainsRequired: Choose at least one domain, or the whole organization.
referenceLibrary.removeConsequence: No assistant draws on "{{title}}" from now on. Terms and definitions that cite it keep their citations.
referenceLibrary.discardConsequence: "{{title}}" leaves the library and no assistant draws on it.
referenceLibrary.needsReembeddingHelp: Embedded with {{model}}, not the organization's current vector model.
referenceLibrary.reembedFailedHeading: These documents could not be re-embedded and are unchanged:
referenceLibrary.helpWhat: A short, chosen set of reference documents (policies, regulations, contracts, processes), added by file or URL. Not a document store.
referenceLibrary.helpWho: Polly answers from it, citing passages. AI agents connected through Provisa's MCP server search it (search_reference_library). Find terms reads it to propose glossary terms and definitions.
referenceLibrary.helpSees: An assistant acting for a role draws only on kept documents in domains the role reads, plus whole-organization ones.
referenceLibrary.helpEmbedding: Passages are embedded with the organization's embedding model when a document is added; Re-embed is needed only when that model changes.
